QuestInfo.name: Where Everybody Knows Your Name
QuestInfo.0: Luminous has confirmed my worst fears. I've been completely forgotten by Maple World. Is there any reason for me to stay, then?
QuestInfo.1: You left Maple World and returned to Fox Point Village. At least there's one place where people know you. Since you were gone for so long, you should go see Chief Silver first.
QuestInfo.2: You returned to Fox Point Village. But...it feels different from before.

no.0: But what about the Black Mage? Even if I...don't exist, I can still fight...
